tier: Tier 2 — SIMULATED recovery against scripted, frozen personas. Never present these numbers as real-world proof (CLAUDE.md law 8).
scope: 60 invoices / 12 debtors (data/invoices.json), Scene 1 only. No Tier-0/reserve-failover row: that mechanic is cart-only (Scene 2), out of scope here.

A_silence.description: No intervention of any kind for 45 days.
A_silence.note: 0% recovery is a direct, honest consequence of the frozen persona tables having no self-cure-without-a-message probability defined - not a claim that real-world silence recovers nothing.

B_generic_reminder.description: Flat reminder every 3 days, no escalation, no instrument, no judgment layer.
B_generic_reminder.note: No escalation ladder exists in this arm, so 'false-escalation rate' is not applicable (not zero).

C_promise_keeper.description: Full system: triage, promise extraction, trust-weighted escalation, bounds-gated instrument choice.
C_promise_keeper.false_escalation_definition: % of firm/formal-stage escalation sends that went to an entity which ended KEPT anyway (measured proxy, not individual counterfactual certainty)
C_promise_keeper.scope_note: This figure is invoices only (per this report's scope), and will not match the previously-published Rs.23,31,496 whole-world figure in TRACK_BAR.md/BUILD_QUALITY.md - that figure additionally includes the 2 Tier-0 reserve-cart recoveries (Rs.1,899 + Rs.5,250 = Rs.7,149), which are a Scene 2/cart mechanic out of scope for this report. Reconciled exactly: Rs.23,31,496 - Rs.7,149 = Rs.23,24,347.
